resources.string: Note %1$d · %2$s. Tap to open; Stop ends dictation.
Audio is sent directly to your Astering server. No audio file is saved. Leaving the app ends recording.
Background recording is enabled for this session. Audio is sent directly to your Astering server, with no audio file saved. Use the ongoing notification to stop.
Could not open Astering. Check your connection and try again.
Update Android System WebView to use native live dictation.

Local recognition runs on this phone with SenseVoiceSmall. Audio is never saved. Recognized text is encrypted on this device until synced to your current account. At most 2,000 passages or 8 MiB are kept; recording pauses if full. Background recording follows your selected option; use the notification to stop.
You have the latest Android version. Only Android packages in stable Releases count; server releases do not trigger an update.
Could not check GitHub updates. The network may be unavailable or rate limited. Try again later; you can keep using the app.

Installed: %1$s
Available: %2$s
Download: %3$.1f MiB

Download directly from GitHub, verify integrity and signing identity, then confirm installation in Android. Keep the app open while downloading. Canceling does not affect server data.
Download complete. Verifying integrity, version and signing identity…
Download or verification failed. No update was installed; incomplete files were removed. Check your network and free storage, then try again.
The package passed SHA-256, app identity, version and signing checks. Installation restarts the app. Save drafts and stop recording first; server content is preserved.
Allow “Install unknown apps” for Astering in Android settings. After returning, tap “Check for updates” then “Install update” to continue.
Could not open the Android installer. Try again, or download and install the APK from Astering GitHub Releases.
Enter your own Astering HTTPS server address. Nothing is connected until you enter and confirm it. Use the root address, without a login page or API path.

Changing servers stops recording and synchronization, and clears website login and browser storage. Save website drafts first. Pending local transcripts stay encrypted and separated by server and account; server notes are not deleted.
Trust and connect to this server?

%1$s\n\nOnly this HTTPS origin will receive your login and native recording requests. Connecting clears existing website login and browser storage and stops current recording. Save drafts first. Pending local text remains separated by its original server.
Enter a valid HTTPS root address, optionally with a port. Do not include passwords, a page path, query parameters or a fragment.
Stopping the previous session and clearing website login, cache and storage before connecting…
Could not save the server choice. No new server was connected. Try again after checking available device storage.
Old-format pending text can only be recovered after you manually select its original server and sign in with a server-verified account. It will never be assigned to a different server automatically.
No old-format pending transcripts were found for this verified account.
Stop recording before recovering old pending text.

%1$d old-format passages are stored on this phone.

Restore them only to the verified account on:
%2$s

After confirmation, each passage is re-encrypted with its server and account scope before the old copy is removed, then synchronization resumes. Choosing Later keeps the old files unchanged. Removing an APK from GitHub does not delete these files; uninstalling the app does.
Recovering encrypted local text. Original copies are kept until each new copy is safely written…
Local recovery completed. Pending text will synchronize to this server when the connection and account are available. This message does not mean the server has already saved every passage.

Recovery could not finish. Unprocessed originals remain on this phone. Check free storage and the verified account, then try again from Client settings. Successfully recovered passages are safe to retry without duplicate server entries.
Dictation or final transcript saving is still running. Stop recording and wait for it to finish, then tap Check for updates to install. The verified package is kept.
Previous login cleanup did not finish. No server was connected. Wait a moment and confirm the address again; old pending text remains safe.
Closing this window returns to the current page. Changing servers requires a separate confirmation and clears website login and browser storage.
